items.title: Anthropic cracks open Mythos for cyber professionals
items.summary: Policy: A new cyber verification program is the first major expansion of Mythos access since its locked-down April launch: a defense tier for incident response and malware reverse engineering, a red-team tier for limited offensive work with enhanced vetting, and a government-approved specialized tier — the only one with mandatory data retention — for testing high-risk systems like power grids and financial plumbing. That last tier replaces and expands Project Glasswing.

items.title: The real trade-off right now: great UX or the best model
items.summary: Business: Dots is freshly released and embedded inside ChatGPT, but gives you one of the most powerful models anywhere. Muse has really dialed-in consumer UX but runs MuSpark — not a bad model, but certainly not GPT-6 Astra. Capabilities may converge eventually; today the trade-off is real. And Hermes and OpenClaw's technical setup alone will cut off a whole set of users regardless of UX.

items.title: The accounting convention that won't survive the IPOs
items.summary: Business: Anthropic quotes gross revenue before revenue sharing — counting tokens sold through Amazon or Microsoft even when big chunks go to those partners — while OpenAI has always used net.
